title: Not worth the money
body: Does what it says on tin, but in a rather awkward way. UI does not follow normal conventions; and sadly not in a way that makes the app more convenient once you learn how to use it. While it syncs status of your tasks, it will not sync your notification settings. Combined with a default of notifying/reminding at random times (why?) rather than defaulting to no reminder you are forced to remove reminders on all your devices every time you add a task to avoid getting reminders all day. The app reminds me of 90s where a lot of software was written by amateurs with little UI design experience and where doing your own thing with the hope of perhaps making the UI much easier to use (it never was) was still acceptable. That said, the app does what it claims to do and I love that it is a one time purchase. Just not worth the money

title: Really good
body:
I’ve only used it for three days so far so I can’t speak for long term usage. But so far I’m really impressed. It’s really clean and simple, good integration with Apple Health, excellent to be able to use shortcuts as actions. The widget is also extremely good, and that’s perhaps the most important thing, to get a good reminder each time I unlock my phone.
All the other habit trackers I’ve used so far I’ve given up on almost right away. This one has kept me going for three days, which is a new record.
I’ll revise my review after a few months if I continue to use it and what I think about it. Perhaps it will earn a 5 star.
But so far so good!

title: I’ve tried all apps in this category...
body:

First of all because it syncs perfectly with Apple Watch and secondly because it works with family sharing.

It’s simple and intuitive and I love that it pulls data from Apple Health and other places to automatically track goals.

Thanks to this app I remembered to do gratitude lists every day for 25 days and my life is completely different now!

Also I love the fact that there is an AA symbol for alcoholics that really has a need of forming habits and naturally get addicted to the wonderful sound of completing a task. Genius!

Thank you guys! 

Love.
